name: Secutor
description: Secutor is a local-first secure packet utility. It keeps private keys inside encrypted on-device real or decoy vaults, creates transport-neutral encrypted packet files/text with X25519 + ML-KEM-768 hybrid encryption and Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 signatures, supports AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 payloads, sequence/replay protection, encrypted attachment chunks, self-destruct policies, local Shamir recovery, multiple identities, QR invites, and offline transport handoff without accounts or Internet permission.
releaseNotes: v0.2.1 hardening/polish release: adds StrongBox/hardware-backed Keystore policy options, explicit sending-identity display and confirmation in Compose for switched or Anonymous/Research/Military identities, a warning gate before local 3-of-5 Shamir recovery share generation, identity retirement/rotation that preserves retired identities for historical verification, and canonical AES-256-GCM / ChaCha20-Poly1305 protocol test vectors for future cross-platform clients. Keeps package com.lenomila.cipherpacket, no Internet permission, the Antarctica signing certificate, and Android signing lineage from the original Turkey cert.
